title: Vasudha
desc: Sarika reveals Vasudha's cooking to Chandrika. Later, Vasudha flees but is kidnapped en route while Hanumant informs Chandrika of her exit.

title: Saru
desc: Despite it being her own birthday, Saru has to work a part-time job. To make matters worse, she is later harshly scolded for arriving late.

title: Hamari Radha
desc: Girdhar returns home after spending time with Shanaya and loses his temper. His harsh words end up deeply hurting Radha.

title: Bhagya Laxmi
desc: Jayshribai, an ageing devadasi, does not want her beautiful daughter Kashi to follow her footsteps into the tradition. However, Bappaji, the head priest, opposes this decision.
